jobs.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.
Job Title:
Investment Manager
Company:
Prologis

A day in the life
The Investment manager will play a key role on the Capital Deployment team, supporting acquisitions, redevelopment, and development activities in the Houston, Austin, and San Antonio market. This individual will partner closely with the region’s Capital Deployment team members and cross-functional teams to identify, evaluate, and execute investment opportunities.
Key responsibilities include:
- Partner with Investment and Market Officers, Development, Entitlement, and Leasing teams to source and execute capital deployment opportunities, including land acquisitions, value-add redevelopments, developments, single-asset and portfolio acquisitions, and select M&A opportunities.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with external partners including brokers, architects, contractors, engineers and other consultants to expand deal flow and market intelligence.
- Identify and present new investment opportunities by analyzing market trends and competitive dynamics.
- Conduct comprehensive macroeconomic and market research initiatives, monitor key trends, and prepare presentations that inform investment strategy.
- Lead underwriting, feasibility analysis, and financial modeling (DCF, pro forma, Argus, Excel) to evaluate acquisitions and speculative development projects.
- Prepare and deliver investment memos and presentations for senior management and the Investment Committee.
- Support quarterly reporting and ongoing evaluation of the existing land bank and pipeline.
- Provide analytical and execution support to advance new business opportunities.

Building blocks for success
Required:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in real estate (investment, finance, development, or private equity).
- Advanced understanding of real estate finance, equity capitalization structures, and valuation concepts (NPV, IRR, cap rates).
- Experience reviewing and preparing key real estate documents (LOIs, offering memorandums, leases, market reports, RFPs).
- Strong financial modeling skills in Argus and Excel.
- Excellent communication, analytical, and presentation skills with attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
- Willingness to travel up to 25% locally.

Preferred:
- Proven ability to source and execute deals independently.
- Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field.
- Knowledge of Houston, Austin, and San Antonio real estate market.
- Collaborative, team-oriented approach with ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners.
- Strong writing and verbal communication skills, with ability to distill complex concepts clearly.
- Highly motivated, organized, and adaptable with a strong sense of ownership.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with Salesforce, Yardi, PeopleSoft, or similar systems is a plus.
- Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

Hiring Salary Range of: $123,000 - $154,000 USD. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

A day in the life
As an SVP, Investment Officer within our Central Region you will lead a team of real estate investment professionals focused on growing Prologis’ investment activities and competitive position in the Dallas market. In this position, you can expect to handle all capital deployment activities including acquisitions, dispositions and development. You will play a lead role in setting and driving investment strategy, activity, and growth in the marketplace for Prologis. Having a background in setting an investment strategy and leading the origination, growing a team, underwriting and execution of acquisitions, dispositions, and developments is critical for success.

Key responsibilities include:
- Partner with the Leasing and construction teams to drive deal flow by identifying new capital deployment opportunities (includes land acquisitions, speculative and build-to-suit developments, value-add redevelopments, portfolio and single asset acquisitions and M&A and entity investments).
- Provide leadership and direction, fostering a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and alignment with the firm’s values and ethics.
- Leverage existing professional relationships and develop new strategic contacts to generate business opportunities with potential real estate partners, private sellers, brokers, customers, investment bankers, owners, developers, consultants and high net-worth individuals.
- Identify and present new investment opportunities to the Senior Leadership and Prologis Investment Committee.
- Ability to identify, anticipate, communicate and capitalize on market trends to bring industry leading returns to Prologis.
- Develop comprehensive knowledge of the company’s assets, strategy, processes and systems.
- Collaborate with Prologis’ Customer Led Development and Data Center teams.
- Direct all land development and entitlement efforts within the market.

Building blocks for success

Required:
- 12+ years of experience executing industrial real estate transactions (investments across various risk profiles).  Minimum of 5 years managing a team of 3 or more direct reports.
- A leader and team player, a successful candidate must work well in a multi-functional, collaborative environment, and demonstrate a strong work ethic and a committed customer service mentality.
- Demonstrated experience/successful track record sourcing, originating, acquiring, negotiating and closing commercial/industrial real estate transactions in the U.S.
- Proven ability to develop, cultivate and manage high quality relationships with owners, operators, high net-worth individuals and intermediaries in the industry.
- Strong knowledge of the U.S. real estate market, with direct past/current experience in Dallas and Texas markets.
- Strong leadership experience and a history of teamwork and collaboration.

Preferred:
- Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

A day in the life
Prologis OnPrem Power is seeking a VP, Operations - OnPrem Power & Mobility to partner with the Global Head of OnPrem Power & Mobility in scaling one of the company’s most strategically important business lines. This role serves as a senior operational and strategic right hand, driving execution, cross-functional alignment, and organizational effectiveness across the OnPrem Power & Mobility platform. As demand accelerates for resilient, localized energy infrastructure, this role will shape the strategic development of the OnPrem Power and Mobility business and turn vision into growth-based results and outcomes. The VP will work closely with the OnPrem/Mobility Leadership Team, the wider Energy Leadership Team, executive stakeholders, customers, partners, and internal functions including real estate, energy, operations, finance, and legal, to ensure Prologis is able to meet its customers access to power and electrification needs through the delivery of onsite energy infrastructure projects.

Key responsibilities include:
- Act as a senior-level trusted thought partner to the Global Head of OnPrem Power & Mobility by prioritizing focus areas, structuring decisions, and driving follow-through.
- Partner with the OnPrem/Mobility Leadership Team and participate in the wider Energy Leadership Team to define and implement the most critical strategic priorities for the OnPrem business line.
- Represent the business unit and the Global Head of OnPrem Power & Mobility in executive forums, customer and partner engagements, internal stakeholder meetings, and cross-functional working groups.
- Lead execution of top priorities in collaboration with real estate, energy, operations, finance, legal, and other internal partners, coordinating across internal and external stakeholders to remove friction and deliver impact.
- Manage a team of energy professionals supporting time-sensitive, high-impact energy projects, while partnering with finance and commercial leaders to shape commercial structures, business models, and guardrails for emerging products and services.
- Own the operating rhythm for the business, including staff meetings, strategic reviews, quarterly planning, goal setting, KPI measurement, and visibility into execution against critical business priorities.
- Drive clarity around the evolving OnPrem Power organization structure, reporting lines, operating model, decision-making authority, governance processes, controls, team onboarding, and cross-functional integration with solar/storage, sustainability, strategic capital, data centers, and key real estate business lines.
- Shape executive communications, leadership engagement, team rituals, communication norms, and collaboration models that reinforce strategy, create alignment, and support the OnPrem Power culture.

Building blocks for success
Required:
- 10 years + experience shaping and executing strategic priorities for a business line, platform, or comparable operating models.
- 10 years + experience leading cross-functional programs with internal and external stakeholders.
- 5 years + experience serving as an operational partner to senior executive leaders.
- 5 years + experience managing teams or operators supporting time-sensitive, high-impact initiatives.
- Ability to build operating rhythms, governance processes, performance measures, and accountability mechanisms that support scale and speed.
- Ability to shape executive communications and leadership engagement that reinforce strategy and create alignment.

Preferred:
- Experience in energy, mobility, real estate, infrastructure, solar/storage, sustainability, strategic capital, data centers, or related business lines.

This two-year program offers a structured pathway for professional learning, growth, and development, providing participants with hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to diverse areas of the business.
